name: changes
cmd:
for c in dyad-operator $(ls crafts 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.md$'); do r=dyad; [ "$c" = dyad-operator ] || r="crafts/$c"; [ -f "$r/VERSION" ] || continue; t=$(git tag -l "$c-v[0-9]*" --sort=-v:refname | head -1); n=$(git rev-list --count ${t:+$t..}HEAD -- "$r"); ids=$(git log --format='%s%n%b' ${t:+$t..}HEAD -- "$r" | grep -o 'd-work #[0-9]*' | sort -u | tr '
' ' '); printf '%s since %s (VERSION %s): %s commits; %s
' "$c" "${t:-no tag}" "$(cat "$r/VERSION")" "$n" "${ids:-no d-work cited}"; done; t=$(git tag -l 'v[0-9]*' --sort=-v:refname | head -1); printf 'bundle since %s (BUNDLE.md %s)
' "${t:-no tag}" "$(sed -n 's/^version: *//p' BUNDLE.md 2>/dev/null)"
output_tail:
disclosure since no tag (VERSION 0.1.0): 1 commits; d-work #166 
sysadmin since sysadmin-v0.3.0 (VERSION 0.3.0): 0 commits; no d-work cited
sysarch since sysarch-v0.3.2 (VERSION 0.3.2): 0 commits; no d-work cited
syseng since syseng-v0.4.1 (VERSION 0.4.1): 0 commits; no d-work cited
bundle since v0.16.2 (BUNDLE.md 0.16.3)

name: number
cmd: : "${CRAFT:?dyad-operator, a craft or bundle}" "${CLASS:?critical-fix, capability, enhancement, breaking or maintenance}"; case "$CRAFT" in bundle) p=v;; *) p="$CRAFT-v";; esac; t=$(git tag -l "${p}[0-9]*" --sort=-v:refname | head -1); v=${t#"$p"}; v=${v:-0.0.0}; M=${v%%.*}; r=${v#*.}; m=${r%%.*}; P=${r#*.}; case "$CLASS" in critical-fix) P=$((P+1));; capability|enhancement) m=$((m+1)); P=0;; breaking) if [ "$M" = 0 ]; then m=$((m+1)); P=0; else M=$((M+1)); m=0; P=0; fi;; maintenance) echo "maintenance: no release; the change set waits (last ${t:-none})"; exit 0;; *) echo "unknown CLASS $CLASS"; exit 2;; esac; echo "${p}${M}.${m}.${P} (last ${t:-none}, class $CLASS)"
